title: Where the Sengled Matter code is
description: Sengled Matter Wi-Fi bulbs ship with the Matter QR code on the quick start guide. The code works for the first ecosystem only; pairing mode closes after 15 minutes and reopens with a power cycle.
lede: Keep the quick start guide. Sengled's own Q and A points Alexa users at the QR code on that guide, and the bulb pairs without the Sengled app.

rows.text: Sengled's Matter Q and A: if prompted, scan the QR code on the quick start guide. The bulb is not compatible with the Sengled Home app, so there is no in-app copy. Whether the code is also printed on the bulb body is not stated.
The Matter setup code can only be used to add the device to the first ecosystem. For others, generate a new code in the first ecosystem's app, for example Alexa, Other Assistants and Apps.
Turns off by itself after 15 minutes. Turn the bulb off and on to reopen it.
Sengled's support site was not reachable when this page was checked, so the quick start guide and the user guide are the references.
